custom_dimensions.rationale: Which entry point (home hero, check page, sticky bar) started, completed and qualified free checks. Decides where the free check is placed. Closed three-value enum.
Whether a started check was entered as a PIN or an address. Decides which input the form leads with. Closed two-value enum; never the typed value.
Which canonical outcome a completed check produced. Shows how much of the completed-to-qualified drop is the evidence rather than friction. Closed enum from the outcome matrix.
Which tier (T2 or T3) a checkout attempt was for. Purchase already carries the tier as the built-in item variant.
Why a checkout attempt did not reach Stripe. Decides which gate or failure to work on first. Closed eleven-value enum; never the server message.

key_events.rationale: Server-side purchase from the signed webhook after settlement and the durable PAID transition. The only key event. Behavioral evidence only: paid revenue is the Stripe/order record.

enhanced_measurement.rationale: Enhanced Measurement 'Page changes based on browser history events' must be OFF on the web stream. The app sends its own SPA page_view with a governed page context; the automatic history-change page_view duplicates it and carries the raw URL.
Enhanced Measurement 'Site search' must be OFF on the web stream. It lifts raw query-string values (which can hold an address or a PIN) into view_search_results events outside the funnel contract.

Enhanced Measurement 'Outbound clicks' sends a click event carrying the raw destination link_url, outside the funnel contract and the governed page context. Owner decides; the readback fails until a posture is recorded. Recommended posture: OFF.

Enhanced Measurement 'Form interactions' sends form_start and form_submit events carrying form ids, names and the raw form_destination URL, outside the funnel contract; the free check and checkout forms already report through governed funnel events. Owner decides; the readback fails until a posture is recorded. Recommended posture: OFF.

Enhanced Measurement 'File downloads' sends a file_download event carrying the raw link_url and file name, which for a delivered report or packet link can identify the order. Owner decides; the readback fails until a posture is recorded. Recommended posture: OFF.
